auth.status: confirmed-live-2026-09-24 (plain HTTP, no MFA on the account)
steps: GET  ForgeRock authorize with the cookie -> Salesforce idp callback -> {epc}/callback/forgerock?code&usid
POST {epc}/apigee-token  Authorization: Bearer <access_token>, body {usid} -> {token}  (the catalogue token)

_note: Everything here is confirmed against the live EPC (2026-09-24). Request bodies are built in jlr/src/catalogue.js (`bodies`) and match what the EPC front end sends.

vinDecode.response: responseObject[]: vin, regNum, catID/catHieID (model catalogue, where the tree starts), catDescription, buildDate, primaryFeatures, minorFeatures

nextLevelHierarchies.response: responseObject.catalogueHierarchies[]: catHieId, catHieType (2 major, 3 minor, 4 page), catHieDesc, applicableInd. A page answers success:false 'Next level hierarchy is not available.'

catEntries.response: responseObject.catalogueEntries[]: apn, callOutCode, catEntryDesc[], quantity, unitPrice, currency, applicableInd, cpFromVIN, cpToVIN

majorSections.status: not used by the EPC front end - the tree starts from vinDecode's catID via nextLevelHierarchies

body.searchType: SECTION (pages by name) or PART (part descriptions)

searchCatalogues.response: SECTION: sectionDTO[] catHieId, sectionNumber, catHieDesc, applicableInd. PART: catalogueHieRespDTO[] with callOutCode, catHieId and catEntries[] (apn, epn, unitPrice, applicableInd). Whole-phrase match on names; PART search can miss parts, so the code uses SECTION then catEntries.
